in_hebrew.name: Tessi
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Harvest, God's gift
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tessi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘tes’ meaning harvest. In Christianity, Tessi represents God's gift and the blessings of the earth. The name holds a deep spiritual significance and is often given to girls born during the harvest season.
